title: VeloraOS 1.10.53 - Native Mobile PWA & Appliance Controls
releaseNotes: Fixes greyed-out VeloraOS OS power/service controls by recognising provisioned VeloraOS appliance markers and reporting the exact availability reason.
Adds a native-style standalone mobile shell with an iOS-like navigation bar, refined bottom tabs, touch feedback and safe-area layout.
Adds keyboard-aware visual viewport handling so Chat and the composer stay correctly sized when the iPhone/iPad keyboard opens.
Adds in-app bottom-sheet confirmations and toast feedback instead of browser-looking prompts for appliance actions.
Adds iOS Home Screen launch artwork, PWA shortcuts, deep-link restoration and supported app-badge integration.
Upgrades the service-worker app shell while continuing to exclude API, backup and recovery data from offline caching.
